# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen in Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c11 P17](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0017), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

She has lovely skin and curly brown hair, which she styles fashionably. She is a plump, cheerful girl with a round, rosy face, and she is described as being wholesome and sweet.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c21 P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009), [v1 c23 P1](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0001), [v3 c36 P2](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0002)_

## Personality

Odette is a pragmatic, sensible, and cheerful girl who approaches life without overly dramatic romantic illusions. She is honest, kind-hearted, and possesses a steady, unshakeable composure in difficult situations, though she is prone to crying during emotional moments. She lacks vanity or pretense, being content with her practical nature, and does not hold grudges or indulge in petty gossip.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v3 c36 P2](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0002)_

## Goals

- To earn an independent income as a schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley, attending the local school where she studied for entrance exams under Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Agnes Thorne. She formed a close friendship with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, participating in school activities, the Sunday-school choir, picnics, and the Village Improvement Society. After qualifying for her teaching license at Regent’s Academy, she accepted a position as the schoolteacher in Stonebridge. After teaching for some time, she relocated to the Canadian West, where she met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy English mining investor from Winnipeg, before traveling to Europe for her honeymoon and settling in a Winnipeg mansion.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c36 P2](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0002), [v4 c2 P2](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0002), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mr. Gorham Pullen and sister to Barney, Mattie, Alice, and Morley Pullen  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P28](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0028)</sub>
- Attended Brierley School and later studied at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- Qualified as a schoolteacher and taught in Stonebridge  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v4 c2 P2](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0002)</sub>
